rows.en: Clovis: "Hey, Arthur.
Have you ever met that Render guy before?"
Arthur: "No. But what he said in the battle just now
has been troubling me, too.
He clearly said he was after me personally."
Clovis: "But that last time was our first fight with him.
I can't think of anything that would make him hate us..."
Arthur: "The only other thing I can think of...
would be that exercise..."
Clovis: "The exercise? You mean the one involving Zigrim,
the one that turned into a skirmish?"
Arthur: "Yes."
Clovis: "It's true that a nearby village
got caught up in the fighting then, but..."
Arthur: "We were distracted by what happened to Melissa,
after all."
Clovis: "That's all I can think of, but...
We can't sacrifice ourselves just to satisfy his grudge,
and I doubt that's what he wants either."
Arthur: "As long as he's after us,
we're bound to meet again, whether we like it or not.
Being hated isn't a pleasant feeling, though."
Clovis: "Yeah. Even if it's the price of fighting,
it still doesn't feel good."
Arthur: "Let's leave it there.
Until all this fighting is over, we should concentrate on being soldiers."
Clovis: "Yeah, I know.
A moment of hesitation on the battlefield can get you killed... Right?"
Arthur: "Yes. Now, let's go to the bridge."
Ymir: "So in the end, the truth remains a mystery..."
Celica: "But he said something strange.
Something about a child with the cursed 'Evil Eye'..."
Ymir: "An 'Evil Eye' is an extremely rare innate ability.
Someone born with it can simply look a person in the eyes
and release feelings from their subconscious, or feelings they've repressed.
The term refers to the person with that power. It's said that only one in several tens of thousands
is born with it...
If Prince Cain has it, and he affected that man,
his ability must be very powerful."
Celica: "But when I met him five years ago, that power didn't seem
to be there..."
Ymir: "I can't imagine an 'Evil Eye' developing due to some outside cause.
In that case, perhaps the power he already had
simply grew stronger,
sometime in the three years since he disappeared from our lives
up to now."
Touya: "So what exactly does that 'Evil Eye'
do?
Can it control people, like hypnosis?"
Ymir: "No. An 'Evil Eye' only awakens emotions
sleeping deep in someone's heart.
It can't force them to do anything."
Clovis: "...Does that mean Oswald wanted,
deep down, to kill the queen?"
Ymir: "Or perhaps it was the flip side of an extreme desire to possess her..."
Reduce: "It's true that the way he looked at Her Majesty
was unnaturally intense... But I never imagined it went this far..."
Clovis: "Then that Cain is at the root of all this?!"
Arthur: "If our assumptions are correct, yes.
It would also explain
why he left us..."
Celica: "But... Cain used to be so kind..."
Ciel: "Reduce, you met Prince Cain in Limberg,
didn't you?"
Reduce: "Yes. The Prince Cain I knew
was already a confident young man, much as he is now,
with something dangerous about him."
Ciel: "I see... But to have been so close
and never realized...
What kind of knight am I, if I couldn't protect Her Majesty...?"
Reduce: "Ciel... I'm sorry."
Ciel: "You have nothing to apologize for.
Grieving won't get us anywhere.
As for avenging Her Majesty..."
Reduce: "Ciel. You mustn't give yourself over to anger.
Have you forgotten Lord Garyud's teachings?"
Ciel: "..."
Garyud: "Yes. It's true that the way he looked at Her Majesty
was unnaturally intense...
But I never imagined it went this far..."
Clovis: "Then that Cain is at the root of all this?!"
Arthur: "If our assumptions are correct, yes.
It would also explain
why he left us..."
Celica: "But... Cain used to be so kind..."
Ciel: "Reduce, you met Prince Cain in Limberg,
didn't you?"
Reduce: "Yes. The Prince Cain I knew was already
a confident young man, much as he is now, with something
dangerous about him."
Garyud: "...Ghh. To have been so close
and never seen through it... How pitiful...
And I call myself a 'Sword Radiance'..."
Ciel: "Father, please don't blame yourself so much..."
Garyud: "...I know. I know, but..."
Ciel: "Father..."
Derock: "...C-Come to think of it, where's Ai?"
Ymir: "Huh? Oh, yes. Ai should be
in her room."
Miyasco: "Will she be all right?
It's her emotional state I'm worried about."
Clovis: "Ai isn't the only one hurting.
Everyone here feels the same.
...But she may be taking it hardest."
Arthur: "Touya, could you go and see how she's doing?"
Touya: "Huh? Well, all right..."
Arthur: "Thank you. I'm counting on you."
Yamato: "You're being unusually agreeable.
What's gotten into you?"
Touya: "When she found out that girl was alive,
she was so happy. Happy from the bottom of her heart.
She's probably hurting more than we can imagine."
Yamato: "...You're right."
Touya: "I know what it's like to lose someone important...
So I figured I could at least try to cheer her up."
Yamato: "Touya..."
Ai: "...Yes?"
Touya: "Hey, it's me. Got a minute?"
Ai: "...Oh, hang on a second."
Touya: "Yeah..."
Ai: "...What's up?"
Touya: "How are you doing? Feeling a little calmer?"
Ai: "Y-Yeah..."
Touya: "Good. I'm glad. Everyone's worried about you,
so why don't you come and see them?"
Ai: "...Okay."
Touya: "All right, let's go, then..."
Ai: "Oh..."
Touya: "Hmm?"
Ai: "Um, you know...
Thank you... for protecting me back there."
Touya: "Oh? You're being honest for once."
Ai: "Hey! I'm trying to be serious!"
Touya: "Ha ha ha! Sorry.
...But I'm glad you're feeling better."
Ai: "...Yeah."
Yamato: "Looks like she's not here."
Touya: "But where else could she...?"
Yamato: "Oh! The infirmary!"
Touya: "The infirmary?"
Yamato: "She must be with Queen Alforinya."
Touya: "I see. Yeah, that makes sense. Let's go have a look."
Ai: "...Alforina. Oswald's dead.
I wanted to avenge you...
I wanted to kill that bastard.
You wouldn't have wanted revenge...
And yet... Why is it, I wonder?
Garyud defeated him in my place,
and I feel relieved...
That's strange, isn't it...?"
Yamato: '...It feels hard to interrupt her.'
Touya: 'Hmm? There's someone else here...'
Yamato: 'Oh, it's Garyud.'
Garyud: "If you kill someone out of hatred, your heart
will fall into darkness. Take that as advice from an older man."
Ai: "...Yes. Um, thank you for what you did earlier."
Garyud: "No. It seems I got a little too worked up
for a man my age."
Ai: "Heh heh..."
Garyud: "Well, it's about time I went."
Ai: "...Yes."
Touya: "Oh... H-Hello."
Garyud: "...The rest is your job.
I'm counting on you, young man."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Ai: "...Touya?"
Touya: "Yeah. Sorry, I wasn't trying to
eavesdrop..."
Ai: "Yeah... I know."
Touya: "Feeling a little calmer?"
Ai: "...A little."
Touya: "I see..."
Ai: "Yeah..."
Touya: "..."
Ai: "...Back then, I really meant
to kill him..."
Touya: "Yeah."
Ai: "But doing that wouldn't have made Alforina
happy.
I knew that, but I turned away from it...
Maybe, in the end, it was just for my own satisfaction.
By doing it, I wanted to ease the burden of failing to protect Alforina...
The burden on my heart, even a little."
Touya: "Ai..."
Ai: "Thank you, Touya.
I'm going to face things properly.
And I'll live for Alforina, too, and carry on her wish...
I'll fight for peace in this world."
Touya: "Don't push yourself too hard.
It's okay to put on a brave face, but please don't forget
that we're here for you too."
Ai: "Y-You're right."
Touya: "Hmm? Something wrong?"
Ai: "N-Nothing!
Now, I'd better go apologize to everyone!"
Touya: "You're a strange one..."
Ai: "...Yes?"
Touya: "Hey, it's me. Got a minute?"
Ai: "...Oh, hang on a second."
Touya: "Yeah..."
Ai: "...What's up?"
Touya: "How are you doing? Feeling a little calmer?"
Ai: "Y-Yeah..."
Touya: "..."
Touya: "...I'm sorry. In the end, I couldn't do anything."
Touya: "I couldn't even capture that bastard..."
Ai: "...No. Never mind that.
Everyone did their best...
So you don't have to apologize, Touya."
Touya: "Ai..."
Ai: "I've worried everyone.
I'd better go apologize properly."
Touya: "All right, let's go, then..."
Ai: "...Okay."
???: "So it failed after all... Queen Alforina is dead,
and we didn't get the crystal..."
????: "It seems working behind the scenes
backfired on us."
???: "Hmph! That's what you get
for using a kid like that."
????: "But that child's ability
was worth using.
It's unfortunate that it ended in failure..."
???: "The 'Evil Eye'? That's nothing but a sham."
????: "Well, it would depend on the person's heart.
More importantly, fortunately, they seem to have headed for the Holy Land."
???: "Luck seems to be on our side,
but at this rate, who knows how long it'll take?
Next time, I'm doing things my way."
????: "Wait. He's in charge of this matter.
I won't allow you to act on your own while he's absent."
???: "I don't know who you think you are,
but I've waited three years, and the moment's finally almost here.
I can't let this chance slip away!"
????: "That's not what I'm saying.
You're too fixated on that.
That's why he's the one handling the direct action, isn't it?
We cannot afford to fail."
???: "Then where is he?
Right now, I'm the only one who can act freely.
Just watch. I'll do my job properly.
Or can't you make any decisions without him?"
????: "...Very well.
If you insist, I'll leave it to you.
But please don't be reckless.
Killing them would defeat the whole purpose."
???: "Yeah, I know."
???: "Heh heh heh... At last..."
